$comment: The commit policy's data: which paths a [no-review] commit may touch, the [hotfix] size limit, the CI skip tokens agents may not write, and the feature-branch shape.
Decided in the commit-policy plan under agent/plans (sections 4 and 5.2) and the operator rulings of 2026-09-25.

Read by .claude/rediacc_hooks/commit_policy.py (load_config), which the pre-bash guards and the git-level hooks under .claude/rediacc_hooks/git/ share. Each key's `value` falls back to commit_policy.DEFAULTS when missing, and test-block_commit_on_main.py asserts the two agree.

no_review_eligible.$comment: Writing only (decision 3): a [no-review] commit's every path must match one of these. `**/` spans any number of directories, `*` stays inside one.

no_review_denied.$comment: Never [no-review], even when an eligible glob matches: .claude/** holds agent programs (commands, agents, output styles, skills) and CLAUDE.md is policy.

hotfix_max_files.$comment: Decision 4: a [hotfix] commit on main touches at most this many files. A larger fix belongs on a branch and a reviewed PR.

skip_tokens.$comment: Section 4.3: GitHub's five skip forms plus the rejected [no-ci]. A skipped workflow leaves the required CI Complete check at Expected forever. Matched case-insensitively; the `skip-checks: true` trailer is matched separately.

branch_shape.$comment: Feature branches are MMDD-N, no suffix. /pr-merge matches a submodule's coordinated branch by this exact name.
